queryName: IAM Role OIDC Trust Unrestricted Sub Condition
descriptionText: An AWS IAM role that trusts an OIDC provider via 'sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' must enforce a restrictive condition on the 'sub' (subject) claim. If no condition restricts the 'sub' claim to an allow-list (negated operators such as 'StringNotEquals' and non-string operators such as 'Null' do not restrict it), or if it is defined using overly permissive patterns (e.g., 'StringLike' with wildcards such as '*', 'repo:*' or 'project_path:*'), any identity capable of obtaining a token from the OIDC provider (any repository, project, or user) may be able to assume the role.
